status: Proposed kinematic construction for owner discussion; no approved production art or game integration
coordinate_system: Schematic units with rim circumradius R=1; z points out of mouth. These are not Unity scene dimensions.

geometry.shape: Three zero-thickness triangular plates meeting at separate tips in the center
geometry.motion: Each plate rotates upward/outward around its fixed exterior base. Closing reverses exactly the same rotation. No vertex, hinge or throat changes size.

teeth.location: Underside/inner surface, away from central tips; hidden by outer surface in closed top view

eye: Separate behind rim with clearance; not part of jaw or closure seam
limits: Zero-thickness plate model does not validate fleshy thickness, neighboring tissue collision, real bite or biology.
Need bevels/gaps at edges and hinges; tooth placement and clearance to eye/neck require artwork review.
Side view shows one plate, not a full three-dimensional collision solver.
The generated open/closed images in this folder are rejected drafts, not illustrations proven to follow this motion.
Inline motion drawing is response content stored in thread visualization space, not a Library artifact.
